title: Gold Master
tagline: The courier's at the door and the games aren't finished!
blurb: The courier's at the door and the games aren't finished! Guide Mo round seven rooms of the Dalex office, carrying work from desk to desk, brewing tea, squashing bugs and shooing Percy the cat. Beat the courier's clock, or pick a relaxed game and let him wait. Every game you ship earns a review mark!

demo.contains: Level 1 demo: Captain Crumpet, level 1 of 4

review.verdict: Not quite solid gold, but this busy little office game is well worth a copy.

quote.text: Still, I kept going back for one more go

credits.name: Kev Mallin, Ruth Ashdown and Stan Thorley for INK & PAPER
